basic_details.job_title: DHS Chengalpattu Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Offline for 115 Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Health Society Chengalpattu (DHS Chengalpattu) has announced 115 vacancies for Contract / Temporary Staff Nurse posts on a contract basis under its 2026 recruitment drive. Candidates possessing GNM or B.Sc Nursing with Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration can apply through the prescribed offline process by downloading the application form, filling it completely, and attaching self-attested copies of all required certificates. age_limit.details: Candidates must be up to 50 years of age to be eligible for the Contract / Temporary Staff Nurse position.

qualification.details: Post Qualification Required Contract / Temporary Staff Nurse Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) or Bachelor of Science in Nursing (B.Sc Nursing) from a government or government-approved private nursing college recognized by the Indian Nursing Council. Mandatory registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council is required.

selection_process: The selection is based on the evaluation of submitted applications meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria and conditions
followed by signing an undertaking for temporary contract placement. There is no written examination mentioned in the official notification.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website at Official Website to download the application form.
Fill out the application form completely with all necessary details.
Attach self-attested copies of all required educational and registration certificates.

Submit the filled application either in person or send it via Speed Post to the Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society (District Health Society), Chengalpattu District – 603001 before 24 October 2026, 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The District Health Society Chengalpattu has advertised a total of 115 vacancies for the contract position.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must be up to 50 years of age to be eligible for the Contract / Temporary Staff Nurse position.

rows.qualification_required: Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) or Bachelor of Science in Nursing (B.Sc Nursing) from a government or government-approved private nursing college recognized by the Indian Nursing Council. Mandatory registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council is required.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process and Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: The selection is based on the evaluation of submitted applications meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria and conditions, followed by signing an undertaking for temporary contract placement. There is no written examination mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHS Chengalpattu Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at Official Website to download the application form. Fill out the application form completely with all necessary details. Attach self-attested copies of all required educational and registration certificates. Submit the filled application either in person or send it via Speed Post to the Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society (District Health Society), Chengalpattu District – 603001 before 24 October 2026, 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Staff Nurse position permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The post is entirely temporary and on a contract basis under the District Health Society, National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit for applying?
faq.answer: Candidates must be up to 50 years of age.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed a Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing from a recognized institution and hold registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 24 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. How should applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted either in person or via Speed Post to the office of the Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, Chengalpattu District – 603001.
